provenance.method: Closed-profile lexical candidates derived from positive fixtures in USG-INTERPRET-GOLD/0.4.1. This resource is intended to exercise deterministic pattern matching and exact source spans, not independent generalization.
limitations: Lexical entries are extracted from the same positive fixtures used by the development corpus; resulting scores are in-sample self-consistency only.
All entries remain candidate-only and must not be promoted to canonical lexical definitions.
No productive English or Arabic morphology is inferred.
Genitive relation semantics remain unspecified; ownership, authorship, and part-whole relations are not inferred from form alone.
